_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (warrens, sacked cellars, and dark holes)

branch.regression: nasal snickers + barks (gh -> gn, kh -> k'k, vowels nasalize, spiteful suffix -snik/-gik)
branch.nature: small, sneaking, spiteful; cowardly in the open, vicious in the dark
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a goblin's whining sneer

_note: Beastman culture: GOBLINS, small, sneaking, spiteful - Kazhur rotted into nasal snickers and barks (qatal 'kill' -> gatak-snik). ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Gnawing Dark / the Skulking Rat). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed (no gendered ending). Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Goblin (Kazhur, nasal-bark regression): gh -> gn, kh -> k'k, vowels nasalize, spiteful suffixes -snik/-gik/-nik; whiny, sneering, barked.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC with nasal codas and bark-clusters; sneering intonation.

morphology.naming_marker: named by the kashnik with a sneer; a spiteful bark-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / warren (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic. Race-totem the Gnawing Dark / the Skulking Rat. The kashnik snickers to the totem and the Gul-spirits over loot-piles in the dark; the One and the sun demonized.
religion.race_totem: the Gnawing Dark (Akhnik-khashnik) / the Skulking Rat
religion.shaman_rites: snicker-chants over loot-piles and the totem's rat-skull; spiteful curses.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gnawing Dark: a black hole full of teeth

banks_patterns.war_bands: the snicker-named mobs: 'the Sneaks', 'the Loot-snatchers', 'the Backstabbers of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: warrens, sacked cellars, and loot-piles: 'the Warren of [tribe]', 'the Gnaw-tunnels of [chief]', 'the Loot-pile of [name]'
